sources.query: Etched Sohu "500,000 tokens per second" Llama 70B 8xSohu replaces 160 H100s
summary_quotes: Etched says one 8-chip Sohu server can serve over 500,000 Llama 70B tokens per second.
Benchmarks are for Llama-3 70B in FP8 precision: no sparsity, 8x model parallel, 2048 input/128 output lengths.
Etched says one 8xSohu server matches 160 H100s.
Outlets attribute the H100 baseline to roughly 23,000 tokens per second for an eight-GPU Nvidia H100 system.
One outlet also cites about 45,000 tokens per second for a B200 server.
One review says the 500,000 tok/s number comes entirely from Etched's own marketing materials and demo videos.
sources.note: Text written by the search engine's summary, not page text read here. Wording and approximate figures are UNVERIFIED until checked against the primary page.
